description: Work telemetry generated through versioned domain commands; fixture text only, no external business evidence.
gaps: These text-only Works have no named business procedure or browser/page-read telemetry.
No host producer supplies payment approval, payment amounts, order history, vendor receipts or subscription-CLI connection proof for these text-only Works.

Confirmed enterprise steering followed by continued active/settled churn has no producing continuation path: domain steer sets waiting and settle-task rejects waiting; plain member exchanges and all three Copy controls are supported.

src/assistant-conversation.ts (AssistantConversation, message/turn/Work/run identities and source validation)

src/runtime-lifetime.ts (bounded ownership and no-replay unknown interruption)
